newsitem.title: USA: ERD says NY seeks Long Beach plant closing.
newsitem.headline: ERD says NY seeks Long Beach plant closing.

text.p: ERD Waste Corp said Friday it has been served with a complaint by the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) seeking to close the company's Long Beach, N.Y., resource recovery facility.
The company said the facility accounts for about 13 percent of ERD's continuing revenues.

"The company believes the facility is in substantial compliance with all DEC regulations," ERD President Joseph Wisneski said, adding that the company believes it can resolve the issue and continue to safely operate the facility.
